text:
Lena (PM): Quick postdeploy triage: received two customer escalations and a telemetry alert. Need to decide what goes into hotfix lane vs next sprint.
Priya: tl;dr on the escalations?
Lena (PM): 1) Search rerank wrong top-k after model swap (customers see irrelevant doc at rank 1). 2) Embedding latency spike for documents >50k tokens when using streaming chunker. Also saw a memory OOM alert on one Dedicated node (non-customer impacting).
Carlos: rerank sounds correctness-critical. Is it model behavior or ranking pipeline bug?
Ellen: initial investigation: the reranker scoring function index->score mapping seems to apply an outdated normalization when model outputs contain extra tokens. Possibly a postprocess bug in the new scorer. Repro steps in support thread.
Max (SRE): memory OOM was an isolated worker on pool-7, auto-restarted. We captured heap dump. Low frequency so P3 unless we see repeats.
Priya: embedding latency spike: we changed chunk boundary heuristic to preserve semantics; now larger chunks cause long model context -> tokenization/time blowup. Seen on dedicated + hosted for large docs. Filed as #EMB-412.
Lena (PM): suggested triage: rerank = must-fix (customer-facing correctness), embedding latency = urgent (affects search UX for big docs), OOM = backlog/P3. Any objections?
Carlos: agree. For rerank, we should block the model swap rollout. Rolling back to previous scorer is cheap.
Ellen: I can revert scorer change in <30m and run a small A/B to confirm. Acceptance: top-1 relevance improvement back to baseline for a sample of 500 queries.
Priya: for embedding latency, short-term mitigation: lower chunk size threshold in the chunker and enable streaming fallback with `max_context=4096`. I can ship an SDK toggle we can flip per-customer.
Max (SRE): ops plan: if we block the model swap, we should schedule an emergency canary rollback at 03:00 UTC. deploy-bot can handle. Also recommend throttling large-bulk jobs until chunker patch lands.
deply-bot: (typo) -- correcting: deploy-bot: scheduled rollback canary for pool-7 at 03:00 UTC.
Lena (PM): acceptance criteria:
- Rerank must-fix: revert applied OR postprocess fix merged + validation showing top-1 relevance >= baseline on 95% of queries in customer test set.
- Embedding urgent: SDK toggle shipped AND telemetry showing median embedding latency for large docs reduced by 40% in 48h.
- OOM backlog: reproduce locally + patch OR schedule for next maintenance window.
Carlos: timeline: rerank revert now -> tests -> canary. Ellen, pls assign yourself and Carlos.
Ellen: assigned. I'll open PR and include `curl` reproducible check in PR body:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"query":"Q","cands":[...]}'
```
Priya: I'll prepare SDK toggle PR. For hosted customers we'll flip server-side config first.
Max (SRE): I'll add a temporary rule to block bulk jobs >1000 docs on dedicated pools until we've validated. Ops note: this may increase support tickets.
Lena (PM): tradeoffs documented. We'll offer impacted customers routing to hosted endpoints or scheduling larger-batch windows. Add credits if unresolved after 72h.
Ellen: PR up in 20m. Will post canary link here.
Priya: SDK patch target EOD, will include release note with `--large-doc-protection` flag.
Max (SRE): heap dump uploaded to the incident bucket: gs://rwd-infra/dumps/pool-7/1767722222.hprof
Lena (PM): I'm moving rerank + embedding to the "hotfix lane" on the board and tagging customer-impact. OOM to backlog. Follow-up sync 09:30 tomorrow or earlier if rollbacks/canaries show issues.
Carlos: thanks. Team owners: rerank = Ellen + Carlos; embeddings = Priya; OOM = Max.
Ellen: will post validation results here. :white_check_mark:
Lena (PM): great. Quick note for roadmap: these hotfixes will push some feature grooming to next sprint; i'll update stakeholders.
